summary: Lower a static method that does not depend on dynamic constructor-object this/super semantics to a C# static method.

target.notes: Emit a C# static method and rewrite statically resolved `$C.$m(...)` calls.

caveats: JavaScript static methods are ordinary properties of the constructor object, not intrinsically static CLR methods.

tests.name: static utility method
tests.input: class C { static add(a,b){ return a+b; } } console.log(C.add(2,3));
tests.expected_csharp: public static double add(double a, double b) => a + b;

tests.name: edge: inherited call with this-sensitive body excluded
tests.input: class A { static who(){ return this.name; } } class B extends A {} console.log(B.who());
tests.expected_behavior: prints B; this rule must not match because C# static methods have no dynamic constructor receiver
